field_crew_notes: Found 30 ft valley oak limb across all three phases of S02 near P-1201-114; two phases burned down; crossarm split. Opened D1 and closed the tie switch to restore section 3 from PRD1202.
Removed limb and two further hazard limbs from the same oak; tree should be removed under the HFTD program.
Spliced phases A and C, re-sagged span, replaced crossarm. Ready for re-energization at 14:45.
Set replacement pole and transferred conductors.
Replaced transformer CFL2101-T04 with a 50 kVA unit; cleaned up oil.
Set new pole and transferred conductors.
Patrolled section 2 and 3; no cause found; re-energized.
Patrolled the feeder before re-energization; no damage found.
